title: Track Order
text: Where is my order?
answer: Use your order tracking page or open the tracking link sent after dispatch. Enter your order ID to see the latest shipment status.

title: Track Order
text: How can I track my package?
answer: Use the shipment tracking link from your dispatch message. Your order ID or tracking number is the key information needed to locate the package.

title: Track Order
text: Can I check where my parcel is?
answer: Yes. Open the tracking link associated with the order and check the latest carrier scan. Keep your order ID ready if support assistance is needed.

title: Track Order
text: I want to know the current location of my order.
answer: The latest location is available through the shipment tracking page after dispatch. Search using the order ID or tracking number.

title: Track Order
text: Where can I see my shipment status?
answer: You can see shipment status in the order tracking section. The order ID identifies the correct shipment.

title: Track Order
text: How do I find my delivery tracking information?
answer: Open the tracking link provided after the order was dispatched. The order ID or tracking number can be used to identify the shipment.

title: Track Order
text: My parcel is on the way. How do I follow it?
answer: Track the parcel using the carrier tracking link in your dispatch notification. Use the order ID when contacting support.

title: Track Order
text: Is there a way to check my order online?
answer: Yes. Open your orders section and select the order to view its current status and tracking details.

title: Delayed Order
text: My order is delayed.
answer: Check the latest carrier update first. If the promised delivery date has passed, contact support with the order ID so the shipment can be investigated.

title: Delayed Order
text: Why has my package not arrived yet?
answer: A delivery can be delayed because of carrier processing, weather, or operational issues. Check tracking and provide the order ID if the promised date has passed.

title: Delayed Order
text: My delivery is late. What should I do?
answer: Review the shipment status and expected delivery date. If the date has passed, support can investigate the shipment using the order ID.

title: Delayed Order
text: The delivery date has passed.
answer: When the promised date has passed, check the latest tracking event and contact support with your order ID for further investigation.

title: Delayed Order
text: My parcel is stuck in transit.
answer: A shipment may remain at one carrier facility for some time. Check the tracking event and contact support with the order ID if there is no movement after the expected date.

title: Delayed Order
text: Why is my delivery taking so long?
answer: The shipment may be delayed by carrier or operational issues. Track the order and share the order ID if the delay continues.

title: Delayed Order
text: The courier has not delivered my order yet.
answer: Check the latest tracking scan. If delivery is overdue, provide the order ID to support for investigation.

title: Delayed Order
text: My package should have arrived yesterday.
answer: Check the current tracking status first. If the promised date was yesterday and delivery has not occurred, support can investigate using the order ID.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: When will my order arrive?
answer: The estimated delivery date is shown in the order details and tracking page. Delivery estimates can change after dispatch.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: What is the expected delivery date?
answer: Open the order details to view the current estimated delivery date. The tracking page provides the latest carrier update.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: How long will delivery take?
answer: Delivery time depends on the shipping method and destination. The order page shows the current expected delivery date.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: When can I expect my parcel?
answer: Check the estimated delivery date in the order details or tracking page. The date may update after dispatch.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: Can you tell me the delivery ETA?
answer: The latest delivery estimate is available in the tracking details. Use the order ID to locate the shipment.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: How many days until my package arrives?
answer: The delivery estimate depends on destination and shipping method. Check your order page for the current expected date.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: Is my order arriving today?
answer: The latest carrier tracking event and delivery estimate indicate whether the parcel is scheduled for delivery today.

title: Delivery Estimate
text: When should I expect delivery?
answer: The order details show the current delivery estimate. Tracking becomes more precise after the shipment is dispatched.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: My order says delivered but I did not get it.
answer: Check nearby delivery locations, household members, and the carrier proof of delivery. If the package is still missing, contact support with the order ID.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: The tracking says delivered but my parcel is missing.
answer: First check the delivery location and nearby safe places. If it is still missing, report the issue with your order ID.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: Courier marked my package delivered but I have nothing.
answer: Verify the delivery address and nearby locations, then contact support with the order ID if the parcel cannot be found.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: It shows delivered, where is my package?
answer: Review the carrier delivery details and check with others at the address. If unresolved, provide the order ID to support.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: I never received an order that says delivered.
answer: Check whether someone else accepted it and review the carrier proof of delivery. Escalate with the order ID if it remains missing.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: My parcel is marked delivered incorrectly.
answer: Check the delivery scan and nearby safe locations. If the parcel is not found, report it using the order ID.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: The app says delivered but no package is here.
answer: Check with household members and the delivery location. If the package remains missing, contact support with the order ID.

title: Delivered Not Received
text: Delivered status but package not received.
answer: Please check the delivery location and carrier details. Support can investigate the shipment when you provide the order ID.

title: Return Request
text: I want to return my product.
answer: Start a return from the order details, select the item, choose a return reason, and follow the pickup or drop-off instructions.

title: Return Request
text: How can I return an item?
answer: Open the order, select the item to return, choose the return reason, and submit the return request.

title: Return Request
text: I need to send my product back.
answer: Use the return option in your order details. The system will guide you through the return request and pickup or drop-off process.

title: Return Request
text: Can I return what I purchased?
answer: Check the item's return eligibility in the order details and submit a return request when eligible.

title: Return Request
text: Where do I start a return?
answer: Go to your orders, select the relevant item, and choose the return option. Provide the return reason when requested.

title: Return Request
text: I changed my mind and want to return the item.
answer: Open the order and request a return if the item is within the applicable return period and conditions.

title: Return Request
text: Please help me return my purchase.
answer: Select the item in your orders and choose return. Follow the displayed instructions for pickup or drop-off.

title: Return Request
text: How do I send an item back to the seller?
answer: Create a return request from the order page. The approved return instructions will show the next steps.

title: Return Eligibility
text: Is my product eligible for return?
answer: Return eligibility depends on the item, return window, and condition. Check the return policy shown on the order page.

title: Return Eligibility
text: Can I return this item after using it?
answer: Eligibility depends on the item category and condition. Review the item-specific return terms before submitting a request.

title: Return Eligibility
text: What is the return window?
answer: The applicable return period is shown with the order or product return policy. Check the purchase date against that window.

title: Return Eligibility
text: How many days do I have to return a product?
answer: The return period varies by item and policy. Check the return terms attached to the order.

title: Return Eligibility
text: Will you accept a damaged item for return?
answer: Report damage through the return process and select the appropriate reason. Eligibility is assessed using the item condition and policy.

title: Return Eligibility
text: Can I return an opened product?
answer: Some items can be returned after opening while others have condition restrictions. Check the item-specific policy before requesting the return.

title: Return Eligibility
text: My return period may be over. Can I still return it?
answer: Check the purchase date and item-specific return window. Support can review exceptional cases when you provide the order ID.

title: Return Eligibility
text: Does every product have the same return policy?
answer: No. Return conditions can vary by product type. Review the return policy linked to the specific order.

title: Exchange Request
text: I received the wrong size and want an exchange.
answer: Open the order, select the item, and choose the exchange option if available. Select the required size and follow the instructions.

title: Exchange Request
text: Can I exchange my product?
answer: Exchange availability depends on the item and stock. Check the order page for an exchange option.

title: Exchange Request
text: I want a different size.
answer: Request an exchange from the order details when the item is eligible and the desired size is in stock.

title: Exchange Request
text: The product does not fit. Can I replace it?
answer: If the item supports exchanges, select exchange in your order and choose the required size or variant.

title: Exchange Request
text: Can I change the color of the item?
answer: Color exchange depends on inventory and item policy. Open the order and check available exchange options.

title: Exchange Request
text: I need the same product in another size.
answer: Use the exchange option in your order, provided the item is eligible and the new size is available.

title: Exchange Request
text: How do I exchange an item for another variant?
answer: Open the order, choose exchange, and select the available variant. Follow the return and replacement instructions.

title: Exchange Request
text: Can I swap my item instead of getting a refund?
answer: If exchange is supported for the item, you can choose an exchange instead of a standard return.

title: Return Pickup
text: When will my return be picked up?
answer: The pickup date is shown after the return is approved and scheduled. Keep the item packed according to the return instructions.

title: Return Pickup
text: How do I schedule a return pickup?
answer: Submit the return request first. If pickup is supported, the system will display available pickup scheduling options.

title: Return Pickup
text: The return pickup has not happened.
answer: Check the scheduled pickup date and latest return status. If the date has passed, contact support with the return or order ID.

title: Return Pickup
text: Can I choose a different pickup date?
answer: Pickup-date changes depend on the available carrier slots. Use the return tracking or rescheduling option when provided.

title: Return Pickup
text: Where can I see my return pickup status?
answer: Open the return details in your orders section to view the scheduled pickup and latest carrier status.

title: Return Pickup
text: The courier did not come for my return.
answer: Check the scheduled pickup information. If the pickup was missed, use the rescheduling option or contact support with the order ID.

title: Return Pickup
text: Do I need to package the item before pickup?
answer: Pack the item according to the return instructions and keep accessories or documents required by the item policy.

title: Return Pickup
text: Can someone else hand over my return?
answer: Pickup handover depends on carrier and seller requirements. Keep the return package ready with the required order details.

title: Payment Failed
text: My payment was unsuccessful.
answer: Try the payment again using the same or another available payment method. If money was debited, do not retry repeatedly; check the payment status first.

title: Payment Failed
text: Why did my payment fail?
answer: A payment can fail because of bank rejection, insufficient balance, card restrictions, or a temporary payment gateway issue. Check the transaction status.

title: Payment Failed
text: I cannot complete the payment.
answer: Check your payment method, available balance, card or UPI status, and try again once. For a debited amount, verify the transaction status first.

title: Payment Failed
text: Checkout payment is failing.
answer: Verify the selected payment method and try again. If the amount was deducted despite failure, check the payment status before another attempt.

title: Payment Failed
text: My card payment did not go through.
answer: Check card validity, limits, and bank approval. You can also try another supported method.

title: Payment Failed
text: UPI payment failed at checkout.
answer: Verify that your UPI app and bank account are active, then retry once. If funds were debited, check the transaction status.

title: Payment Failed
text: The payment gateway rejected my transaction.
answer: The bank or payment gateway may have declined the transaction. Verify the payment method and retry or choose another method.

title: Payment Failed
text: I got a payment failure message.
answer: Review the payment status and retry once if no amount was debited. For a debit without order confirmation, check the payment status first.

title: Payment Pending
text: My payment is still pending.
answer: Wait for the payment status to update and avoid making repeated payments for the same order. If it remains pending, contact support with the transaction details.

title: Payment Pending
text: The payment status says pending.
answer: A pending status means the transaction has not received a final success or failure confirmation. Wait for the status to update before retrying.

title: Payment Pending
text: Why is my payment stuck on pending?
answer: The bank or payment gateway may still be processing the transaction. Avoid duplicate payments and monitor the transaction status.

title: Payment Pending
text: My UPI payment is pending.
answer: Keep the transaction details and wait for the bank status to update. Do not make duplicate payments while the original transaction is pending.

title: Payment Pending
text: Card payment is showing pending.
answer: The payment is awaiting final confirmation from the payment provider. Monitor the status and avoid duplicate attempts.

title: Payment Pending
text: The money transfer for my order is pending.
answer: The payment provider has not returned a final result yet. Check the transaction status before taking another payment action.

title: Payment Pending
text: It has been a while and payment is still pending.
answer: Check the transaction status and keep the payment reference. Support can investigate a long-pending transaction.

title: Payment Pending
text: Should I retry a pending payment?
answer: Do not immediately retry a pending transaction because the original payment may still complete. Verify the current status first.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: My money was deducted but the order was not placed.
answer: Do not pay again immediately. Check the payment transaction status and contact support with the transaction ID and amount if the order was not created.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: Payment succeeded but I did not receive an order number.
answer: Keep the payment reference and amount. Check your orders section; if no order appears, contact support for transaction verification.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: I was charged but checkout failed.
answer: Check whether the transaction is successful or pending before retrying. Support can trace a debited payment using the transaction ID.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: The money was taken from my account but no order exists.
answer: Please do not make a duplicate payment. Verify the payment status and provide the transaction ID to support.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: Payment got deducted and the order failed.
answer: Check the payment transaction first. If the debit is confirmed but no order exists, support can investigate or process the applicable refund.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: I received a debit alert but no order confirmation.
answer: Use the payment reference to verify the transaction. Avoid duplicate payment until the status is clear.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: My bank account was charged but the order is missing.
answer: Check your payment status and orders page. If there is no order, contact support with the transaction ID and amount.

title: Charged Order Failed
text: The checkout crashed after payment.
answer: Verify whether the payment completed before trying again. If charged without an order, share the transaction reference with support.

title: Payment Methods
text: Which payment methods can I use?
answer: Available methods are shown at checkout and can include supported cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, or other enabled options.

title: Payment Methods
text: Can I pay by UPI?
answer: UPI is available when shown among the payment methods at checkout.

title: Payment Methods
text: Do you accept credit cards?
answer: Supported credit and debit card options are listed during checkout. Enter the card details only on the secure payment page.

title: Payment Methods
text: Can I use net banking?
answer: Net banking can be used when it is available as an option at checkout.

title: Payment Methods
text: What payment options are available?
answer: Open the checkout page to view the payment methods currently available for your order and location.

title: Payment Methods
text: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Cash-on-delivery availability depends on the product, seller, and delivery location. Check the option shown at checkout.

title: Payment Methods
text: Can I pay with a wallet?
answer: Wallet payment is available only when the supported wallet appears in the checkout payment options.

title: Payment Methods
text: Why is my preferred payment method not showing?
answer: Payment options can vary by product, seller, order value, and location. Check the methods currently displayed at checkout.

title: Refund Status
text: Where will I get my refund back?
answer: The refund is normally sent through the original payment channel when supported. Check the refund details in your order or payment history.

title: Refund Status
text: How will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are generally processed to the original payment method or the method specified in the refund details.

title: Refund Status
text: Where does my refund go?
answer: The refund destination depends on the original payment method and applicable refund rules. Check the order's refund details.

title: Refund Status
text: Will my refund come to my bank account?
answer: For eligible bank-based payments, refunds are typically returned through the original payment route. Check the refund status for the exact method.

title: Refund Status
text: How can I check where my refund was sent?
answer: Open the refund details associated with the order to see the refund method and processing status.

title: Refund Status
text: I need to know the refund method.
answer: The refund method is shown in the refund details for the order and may depend on the original payment method.

title: Refund Status
text: My returned order was refunded. Where is the money?
answer: Check the refund status and destination shown in the order details. The time to appear depends on the payment provider.

title: Refund Status
text: Where will the refund amount be credited?
answer: The refund is generally credited through the applicable original payment route. Review the refund details for the order.

title: Refund Pending
text: My refund is pending.
answer: A pending refund means processing has started but the amount has not completed through the payment provider. Check the refund status and reference.

title: Refund Pending
text: Why is my refund taking time?
answer: Refund processing can take time after the return or cancellation is approved. Check the refund status for the latest update.

title: Refund Pending
text: The refund has been initiated but is not complete.
answer: Keep the refund reference and monitor the status. If the stated processing window has passed, contact support.

title: Refund Pending
text: Refund status shows processing.
answer: Processing means the refund is moving through the payment provider. Wait for completion and keep the refund reference.

title: Refund Pending
text: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: The processing time depends on the payment method and provider. The refund status page shows the current stage.

title: Refund Pending
text: My refund has not finished yet.
answer: Check the current refund status and reference. Support can investigate when the applicable processing window has passed.

title: Refund Pending
text: Why is my refund still under processing?
answer: The payment provider may still be processing the refund. Monitor the status and contact support after the expected window.

title: Refund Pending
text: Can you check my pending refund?
answer: Support can investigate a pending refund using the order ID or refund reference.

title: Refund Not Received
text: I have not received my refund.
answer: Check the refund status and expected completion window. If it has passed, contact support with the order ID and refund reference.

title: Refund Not Received
text: My refund says completed but I cannot see the money.
answer: Verify the payment account or statement linked to the original payment method. If the amount is still missing, contact support with the refund reference.

title: Refund Not Received
text: The refund was processed but money is missing.
answer: Check the original payment account and transaction history. If the credit is not visible after the expected window, provide the refund reference to support.

title: Refund Not Received
text: I was told my refund was issued, but I got nothing.
answer: Review the refund confirmation and destination. If the credit is absent after the expected processing period, support can trace it.

title: Refund Not Received
text: My refund has not reached my account.
answer: Check the refund destination and bank or payment statement. Share the order ID and refund reference if it remains missing.

title: Refund Not Received
text: Refund completed but not credited.
answer: Confirm the original payment account and check the refund reference. Support can investigate a missing credit after the expected window.

title: Refund Not Received
text: Why is my completed refund not showing?
answer: A provider may take additional time to reflect a completed refund. Check the original payment statement and share the refund reference if needed.

title: Refund Not Received
text: The app says refunded but my balance has not changed.
answer: Review the original payment account and refund transaction. If the credit is missing beyond the expected time, contact support.

title: Refund Timeline
text: When will I get my refund?
answer: The refund timeline depends on the payment method and provider. Check the refund status in the order details for the current stage.

title: Refund Timeline
text: How many days for a refund?
answer: Refund timing varies by payment method. The order's refund details provide the expected processing window.

title: Refund Timeline
text: What is the refund ETA?
answer: The current refund status and expected processing information are shown in the refund details.

title: Refund Timeline
text: How long after return will I get my money?
answer: After the return is approved and refund processing begins, the payment provider may take additional time to credit the amount.

title: Refund Timeline
text: When should the refund reach me?
answer: Check the refund status and payment method because provider processing times can differ.

title: Refund Timeline
text: How soon will the refund appear?
answer: The refund appears according to the processing timeline of the original payment method. Check the refund details for the expected window.

title: Refund Timeline
text: Can you tell me the refund processing time?
answer: Refund timing depends on the payment provider and payment method. Use the refund status for the current estimate.

title: Refund Timeline
text: Will I receive the refund immediately after return?
answer: Not necessarily. The return may need approval first, followed by payment-provider processing.
